top_choice_rationale: Nd-Fe-B permanent magnets are a discrete, experimentally verified materials invention with exceptional and durable physical performance. Subject to documentary confirmation of the independent original routes and their exact scope, Sagawa and Croat provide a defensible attribution for a bounded invention rather than subsequent optimization or commercial diffusion.
